messages.content:
Alex and Jordan are classmates working on a group project.
Alex: Did you finish your part of the project?
Jordan: I'll finish it tonight.
Alex: Sure, that's fine.

Is Alex being passive-aggressive in the last message?

message.content:
Not necessarily. On its own, “Sure, that’s fine” reads as a straightforward acceptance of Jordan’s plan to finish tonight.

It could be passive-aggressive only with added context—e.g., the project was already due, Alex had repeatedly asked, or the tone was sarcastic/curt. But from the text alone, there isn’t enough evidence to call Alex passive-aggressive.
